parameters.jsCode:
// Template QA Auditor - single source of truth.
// Every rule lives here. Change a list or a number and the whole workflow follows.
const config = {
  workflow_version: "1.0.0",
  title: "Template QA Auditor",
  report_date: "2026-10-06",
  minutes_manual_review_per_template: 6, // ASSUMPTION used only for the time-saved estimate. Edit to match your team.

  owners: {
    compliance: "Compliance",
    clinical: "Clinical Safety",
    config: "Workflow Config",
    content: "Content & Comms",
    data: "Operations Admin"
  },

  severity_weights: { critical: 40, high: 20, medium: 8, low: 3 },

  // US spelling -> UK spelling (whole words, any capitalisation)
  uk_spelling: {
    "organize": "organise", "organized": "organised", "organizes": "organises", "organizing": "organising",
    "organization": "organisation", "organizations": "organisations",
    "finalize": "finalise", "finalized": "finalised", "finalizing": "finalising",
    "recognize": "recognise", "recognized": "recognised",
    "apologize": "apologise", "apologized": "apologised",
    "prioritize": "prioritise", "prioritized": "prioritised",
    "customize": "customise", "customized": "customised",
    "personalize": "personalise", "personalized": "personalised",
    "summarize": "summarise", "summarized": "summarised",
    "minimize": "minimise", "emphasize": "emphasise", "realize": "realise", "realized": "realised",
    "authorize": "authorise", "authorized": "authorised", "authorization": "authorisation",
    "analyze": "analyse", "analyzed": "analysed", "analyzing": "analysing",
    "color": "colour", "colors": "colours", "colored": "coloured",
    "favorite": "favourite", "behavior": "behaviour", "neighbor": "neighbour",
    "honor": "honour", "labor": "labour", "flavor": "flavour", "humor": "humour",
    "center": "centre", "centers": "centres", "centered": "centred",
    "theater": "theatre", "liter": "litre", "fiber": "fibre",
    "defense": "defence", "offense": "offence",
    "catalog": "catalogue", "dialog": "dialogue",
    "canceled": "cancelled", "canceling": "cancelling",
    "traveled": "travelled", "traveling": "travelling",
    "enrollment": "enrolment", "fulfill": "fulfil", "fulfillment": "fulfilment",
    "skeptical": "sceptical", "gray": "grey", "mom": "mum",
    "pediatric": "paediatric", "orthopedic": "orthopaedic", "anesthesia": "anaesthesia",
    "hemoglobin": "haemoglobin", "diarrhea": "diarrhoea", "edema": "oedema",
    "tumor": "tumour", "esthetic": "aesthetic",
    "zip code": "postcode"
  },

  // Wordy phrases -> plain English
  plain_english: {
    "utilise": "use", "utilize": "use", "commence": "start", "prior to": "before",
    "in order to": "to", "assist": "help", "kindly": "please", "ascertain": "find out",
    "endeavour": "try", "subsequently": "then", "at this point in time": "now",
    "due to the fact that": "because", "per our records": "our records show"
  },

  // Placeholders the platform knows about, with a sample value used to estimate rendered length
  known_placeholders: {
    first_name: "Priya", last_name: "Sharma", org_name: "Riverside Health",
    clinic_name: "Riverside Surgery", clinic_phone: "01632 960000",
    appointment_date: "14/10/2026", appointment_time: "09:30",
    booking_link: "https://example.org/b/ab12cd", survey_link: "https://example.org/s/ab12cd",
    unsubscribe_link: "https://example.org/u/ab12cd", reference_number: "REF-48213",
    practitioner_name: "Dr Patel"
  },

  // Approved template types and the placeholders each one must contain
  type_rules: {
    appointment_reminder: { required: ["appointment_date", "appointment_time", "clinic_name"] },
    results_ready: { required: ["first_name", "clinic_name"] },
    marketing: { required: [] },
    survey: { required: ["org_name"] },
    notice: { required: ["clinic_name"] }
  },

  channels: ["sms", "email"],
  sms: { single: 160, multi: 153, unicode_single: 70, unicode_multi: 67, max_segments: 2 },
  email: { subject_max: 60 },

  // Words that must never appear in an SMS body or an email subject line (regular expressions)
  sensitive_terms: [
    "cancer", "\\bHIV\\b", "pregnan\\w*", "miscarriage", "mental health", "depress\\w*",
    "diagnos\\w*", "chlamydia", "hepatitis", "oncolog\\w*", "abortion", "terminal illness"
  ],

  risky_claims: [
    "guarantee\\w*", "100% (?:safe|effective)", "\\bcures?\\b", "\\bcured\\b", "miracle",
    "risk[- ]free", "no side effects", "clinically proven", "instant relief", "permanent (?:relief|results)"
  ],

  pressure_phrases: [
    "act now", "last chance", "limited time", "hurry", "don't miss out",
    "don’t miss out", "while stocks last", "filling fast"
  ],

  allowed_caps_words: ["STOP", "NHS", "UKHSA", "EMMA", "HTTPS", "HTTP", "COVID"],
  allowed_email_domains: ["example.org", "example.com"],
  free_mail_domains: ["gmail.com", "hotmail.com", "hotmail.co.uk", "yahoo.com", "yahoo.co.uk", "outlook.com", "icloud.com"],

  thresholds: { max_sentence_words: 35, max_exclamations: 1, review_below_score: 75 }
};

return [{ json: { config } }];

nodes.name: 16. Respond (HTML report)
nodes.notes: Returns the HTML report when the run started from the webhook. On a manual run it simply passes the data through.

parameters.content:
## Template QA Auditor
Checks communication templates (SMS and email) BEFORE they go live.

All data in this demo is synthetic. Nothing is sent to anyone. It only reports and drafts. A person decides.

All rules live in **2. Load Config**. Your own templates go in **3. Load Templates**.

### What it checks
- UK spelling, US dates, dollar amounts, wordy phrases
- Placeholders: brackets, typos, missing required ones
- Personal data, sensitive terms in SMS, risky claims, marketing opt-out
- SMS length and characters, email subject and sign-off, tone and readability

### Scoring
BLOCKED = any critical issue
NEEDS REVIEW = any high issue or score under 75
APPROVED WITH NOTES = minor issues only
APPROVED = nothing found

### Outputs
HTML report (open via the webhook Test URL), a flat issue list for spreadsheets, suggested wording for a human to approve, and a draft alert message (not sent).
